To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the MIVQUEs for the simple linear regression model with one fold nested error are more efficient than the corresponding REML estimators when the ratio of the variance component estimates is large, and are asymptoticaly efficient as this ratio tends to infinity.

the minimum variance quadratic-unbiased estimators (M IVUEs) of the parameters in a simple linear regression model with onefold nested error are more efficient as a ratio of initial variance components estimates (the ratio of the initial estimates of the error variances) increases and are asymptotic efficient as the ratio approaches infinity.
MIVQUEs of variance components are more efficient than REML estimators and are asymptotical efficient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the MIVQUEs of the variance components in simple linear regression with one-fold nested error.
the problem of estimating the parameters and variance components in a simple linear regression model with one-fold nested error.
the problem of obtaining minimum variance quadratic unbiased estimates (MIVQUE's) for the variance components in the simple linear regression model with onefold nesting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed estimators are efficient and robust in all situations.
the MIVQUEs are the most efficient unbiased estimators of the variance components in simple linear regression with one fold nested error.

MIVQUEs of the variance components in simple linear regression with one fold nested error is more efficient than the usual least squares estimators and the ratio of the MIVQUEs and the usual least squares estimates is asymptotically efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MIVQUEs are asymptotically more efficient than the maximum likelihood estimates (MLEs).
MIVQUE is a good alternative to ANOVA when the ratio of initial variance components estimates is large.
the MIVQUEs are more efficient than the usual unbiased estimators, and the efficiency increases as the initial variance components are more accurate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of onefold nested errors, the MIVQUEs are the most efficient estimators of the variance components in simple linear regression.
, in the case of onefold nested error, it is possible to obtain the explicit form of MIVQUEs.
the minimum variance quadratic estimators are more precise than the ordinary least squares estimators when the ratio of the variance components estimates is large.
